name: Bloomfire
description: Bloomfire is an AI-powered knowledge management and engagement platform that helps enterprises turn static content repositories into a connected system for surfacing trusted knowledge and capturing expertise across teams.
best_for: Positioned for enterprise organizations and global teams — across support, operations, and innovation functions — that need a unified knowledge layer across business units and geographies.
features: AI-powered search and discovery with verified answers and clickable citations
Self-healing knowledge base that flags outdated or redundant content for review
AI-powered authoring tools for auto-tagging, summarization, and categorization
Q&A collective knowledge engine that proposes answers and avoids duplicate questions
Single-copy document publishing with automatic updates across communities
Moderation tools with approval workflows and version control
Analytics suite with real-time visualizations and custom reporting
SOC2, GDPR, SSO, and SCIM support for enterprise data governance
